shortBio.en: Experience guitarist and frontman; feedback, wah, and studio layering on late-1960s sides.
shortBio.zh: Experience 吉他手与主唱；1960 年代末唱片上的反馈、wah 与录音室叠轨。

body.en:
Born 1942, Seattle. Forms the Experience in London, 1966. Guitar technique and Marshall/ feedback vocabulary land on Are You Experienced, Axis, and Electric Ladyland.

Dies 1970.
body.zh:
1942 年生于西雅图。1966 年在伦敦组建 Experience。《Are You Experienced》《Axis》《Electric Ladyland》上的吉他手法与 Marshall/反馈语汇。

1970 年去世。
